_note: Row cards (Yusuf's pick 2026-10-21, replacing silent cluster combos): a row is drafted like a blueprint (2026-10-22), then orders two buildings together, built side by side in one cluster, like neighbouring items in The Bazaar or Backpack Battles. building = the one that gets the effect once it and its partner both stand finished; partner = the other building on the card. The card costs both buildings' costs less row_discount (data/balance.json), and a hand deals at most row_cards of them, drawn from the rows whose two buildings could both go up now (weighted x build_need_weight when the town needs either). Effects: daily_food = extra food it brings in each dawn; craft_speed = its craftspeople work that much faster (1.0 = twice as fast). Buildings ordered on their own cards never make a row. sim/build_hand.gd (dealing, order_row), Town.choose_row (placing), Town.combos_of (effects).
